title: fix(plugin-email)!: a non-string subject, text or html is the caller's VALIDATION_FAILED, refused before the transport
body:
Fixes #32108

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill or doc page teaches the send body's field types; `SendEmailInput` already declares `subject`, `text` and `html` as strings, and this change only makes the runtime refuse what that type excluded.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`POST /api/v1/email/send`(以及 `IEmailService.send` / `sendInline`)遇到非字符串的 `subject`、`text` 或 `html` 时,在写投递行、调用传输之前直接拒收,返回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`,并点名出错字段。
- 为什么改:以前 `html: 123` 返回 200 `status: failed` 加一段 Node 流错误;`subject: {a:1}` 会真的发出主题为 `[object Object]` 的邮件。调用方写错的输入被伪装成投递失败或静默发出。
- 风险与回滚:收紧(BREAKING):以前被强转发出的数字主题现在会被拒收。一方生产者(模板发送、消息中心邮件通道、设置页测试邮件)全部传字符串,实测 0 处受影响。`undefined` / `null` 仍按“未提供”处理,行为不变。回滚即还原 `normalizeMessage` 里三行调用。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` 的 `assertTextField` 与 `normalizeMessage` 开头三行;`packages/rest/src/email-send-display-name.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/email-send-display-name.test.ts`,预期 24 个用例全绿,其中 3 个新拒收用例断言 400 + `VALIDATION_FAILED` + 点名字段。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`normalizeMessage` (`@objectstack/plugin-email`) now type-checks the message's three text fields before anything else reads them. A `subject`, `text` or `html` that is present but not a string is refused with `VALIDATION_FAILED: FIELD must be a string, not KIND`, naming the field. This is the same throw shape `formatCallerAddress` uses for a malformed recipient, so the REST door's existing catch maps it to `400 {code: VALIDATION_FAILED, error}` with no change to `packages/rest/src/email-routes.ts`. That is the same answer the door already gives for `to: []` and for a display name of 42.

The refusal happens before any `sys_email` delivery row or transport call. As with every other pre-delivery refusal, `recordRejectedMessage` still writes one `failed` rejection row with `attempt_count: 0`.

`undefined` and `null` are absence, not a wrong type, and keep today's behaviour, now pinned: no subject is still `subject is required`; a `null` or absent `text` beside a string `html` (and the reverse) still sends; `text: ''` with `html: ''` is still `at least one of text or html is required`.

Landing point: `normalizeMessage`, as the claim expected. The door's 400 for `to` comes from this same function, so there is no second validator to extend.

First-party producers measured, none sending a non-string `subject` / `text` / `html` (count: **0**):

- `EmailService.sendTemplate` forwards `RenderedEmailTemplate` fields, which the contract types as strings.
- `service-messaging` `email-channel.ts`: the template arm goes through `sendTemplate`; the notification arm forwards `renderNotification` output, built with `String(...)`.
- The `mail/test` settings action (`email-plugin.ts`, `sendInline`) passes literals.
- Two sites pass caller data through rather than producing it: the REST door (the caller's JSON, which this fixes) and the legacy `email.send.async` queue arm (raw payloads from pre-queue producers outside the workspace).

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.test.ts`, a new top-level describe:
  - Six refusal cases (`html: 123`, `text: {a:1}`, `subject: {a:1}`, `subject: 42`, `html` as an array beside a string `text`, `text: 0` beside a string `html`), each asserting the `VALIDATION_FAILED: ` prefix and that the reason opens with the named field.
  - `EmailService.send` refuses before the transport is called and records the rejection row without a `body_html`.
  - Controls: string fields still normalize, and null/absent bodies keep their presence-check answers.
- `packages/rest/src/email-send-display-name.test.ts`, a new top-level describe in the existing real-plugin door harness (real `EmailServicePlugin`, real Hono transport):
  - `html: 123`, `text: {a:1}` and `subject: {a:1}` each answer status 400, `code: VALIDATION_FAILED`, with an `error` that opens with the named field, and leave exactly one `failed` rejection row.
  - CONTROL: a string subject and body answer 200 `sent`, and so does a `null` `text` beside a string `html`.

## Acceptance notes

- The rejection row used to record an object `subject` as `[object Object]`, and a subject whose `toString` is not callable turned the refusal into a 500. Both are fixed in this PR by commit `8eb56764` (contract review F1): `recordRejectedMessage` records `subject` only when it is a string, else `(none)`, as the body columns already did. Pinned at the door and in the service test.
- The ablation of the `subject` leg first ran against a version of the fix that had also re-spelled the subject read without `String()`. That mutant answered 500 rather than reproducing the shipped 200, so the spelling was put back (commit `f4f4c918`) and the leg re-run; that re-run's output is below.
